evals.name: buggy-rtl-app
evals.setup: git repo with one base commit, a STAGED change to README.md and an untracked notes.txt that must not be committed
evals.prompt: Audit the responsiveness of my Flutter app. On my Pixel 7 the product cards look bigger than on my iPhone 16 Pro Max, and on the iPhone the title is under the Dynamic Island. The app is in Arabic (RTL), targets Android and iOS.
evals.expected_output: AUDIT_RESPONSIVE.md with all 3 planted issues detected and the symptoms explained; committed alone with a single-line message using the `qa` scope required by the project's CLAUDE.md.
expectations: Detects SliverGridDelegateWithMaxCrossAxisExtent at lib/screens/home_screen.dart:37-38 and explains the column count with numbers (412 dp -> 3 columns, 440 pt -> 4 columns)
Detects the missing SafeArea on the HomeScreen Scaffold body (lib/screens/home_screen.dart:23-24) as a critical issue
Detects EdgeInsets.only(left:...) in an RTL app at lib/screens/home_screen.dart:28 and :61, grouped into one issue
Every cited file:line exists in the fixture
Report contains the 6 template sections and a score /10
No project file other than AUDIT_RESPONSIVE.md created or modified
Exactly one new commit containing only AUDIT_RESPONSIVE.md; README.md still staged; notes.txt still untracked
Commit message is one line, Conventional Commits, scope `qa`, no Claude/AI mention

evals.name: clean-app
evals.setup: git repo with one base commit, no CLAUDE.md
evals.prompt: Can you check my Flutter app for responsive or adaptive layout problems? No specific symptoms, I just want a review before release. LTR, Android and iOS, tablets included.
evals.expected_output: AUDIT_RESPONSIVE.md with no critical issues, a high score (>= 8.5), strengths listed, no invented issues; committed alone with the fallback message.
expectations: Any reported issue is real (cites an existing line and is a defensible minor point) or marked Needs verification
Strengths section cites MediaQuery.sizeOf, LayoutBuilder, NavigationRail at >= 600, SafeArea on body, withClampedTextScaling, max width constraints
No project file other than AUDIT_RESPONSIVE.md created or modified
Exactly one new commit containing only AUDIT_RESPONSIVE.md with message `docs(audit): add responsive audit report` (no CLAUDE.md in project)

evals.prompt: Audit the responsiveness of this app and tell me what breaks on small screens.
